name: 92551 · Moreno Valley, CA
findings: ZIP 92551 (Moreno Valley) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92551 (Moreno Valley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92551 (Moreno Valley) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
